national.line: The Indianapolis Colts are inducting Adam Vinatieri, the NFL's all-time leader in field goals, into the Colts Ring of Honor this Sunday after his fourteen seasons with the team.
A retired Oregon couple facing hard times, Diane and Brian Johnsen, got a brand-new heating and cooling system worth sixteen thousand dollars installed at no cost before winter.
A woman accidentally said 'Love you!' to an important client at the end of a call, and his response was so kind he even followed up with a heartwarming email.
Brendan Fraser surprised a crowd at a screening of 'The Mummy' by showing up in costume, and now fans are begging for a 'Mummy 4.'
Historians explain why men in old-timey portraits always posed with one hand tucked in their vest or coat, and the habit goes all the way back to ancient Greece.
Stanford University scientists reversed coral bleaching at record speed, bringing ghostly white corals back to full health in just seven weeks with a new method.
Google has revealed the biggest Halloween costume trends of 2026, and a pretty bizarre character landed in the number one spot this year.
Candy corn may be Halloween's most divisive treat, but it turns out the love-it-or-hate-it candy has a surprisingly complex history behind it.
Matthew Lillard says his younger self acted like he was trying to win an Academy Award in every single 'Scream' scene, and he finds it hilarious to watch now.
A die-hard New York Knicks fan went viral with a Halloween display that recreates the Finals 'tip in' moment with an undead twist.

local.line: The City of Lebanon has gone back to the drawing board with another new city logo proposal, this time paired with a fresh slogan: 'Build your journey here.'
A neighboring church stepped in and built a ramp for a Lebanon woman to make her daily life easier, a true neighbors-helping-neighbors story.
The Joel E. Barber C-5 school district is considering building a high school add-on to its existing building, and Superintendent Dr. Rachelle Jennings laid out the current building layout.
Congratulations to the Lebanon Jackets, who placed at the Valhalla Marching Festival and brought home a strong finish for the hometown marching program.
On his very first time snagging, a man from Olathe, Kansas, reeled in a world-record 164-pound paddlefish at Lake of the Ozarks last weekend.
Angi Uber is celebrating twenty years at Ozarks Kat and K9 Shelter in Sunrise Beach, where she started out scooping poop and now serves as operations director.
Camdenton beat Capital City in a back-and-forth Week 8 football game, with Michael Maschino scoring the go-ahead touchdown run for the Lakers.
A developer wants to build a 126-room hotel under the Unscripted by Hyatt name in Backwater Jacks' cove at Lake of the Ozarks.
The Lake celebrated the end of another season with the Fall Harbor Hop, drawing nearly 2,300 boaters out on the water for a sunny day.
Patrick Mahomes' mom has set the record straight: no, the Chiefs quarterback does not have a home at Lake of the Ozarks, despite the story going around.
October felt like July at Lake of the Ozarks on Tuesday, October 13, when temperatures hit the low 90s and set a new heat record, according to the National Weather Service.
Here is one for the weather watchers: Springfield temperatures were actually hotter this past September than they were in July.
The Orionid meteor shower peaks next Wednesday night across the Ozarks, with ten to twenty meteors per hour expected under mostly clear skies despite a nearly full moon.
What started as a night of live music in Rogersville has grown into the Rockin' Rogersville community festival, which wrapped its ninth year with music, food and local vendors.
Ronald McDonald House Charities of the Ozarks has a new name, Ronald McDonald House Ozarks, plus a new logo to better reflect its service to local families.
The Community Foundation of the Ozarks is accepting applications for its Everyone Outdoors grant program, with 120 thousand dollars available for projects that connect people to the outdoors.
Down in Ozark, Missouri, there is a restaurant that tosses hot rolls at customers clear across the room, making dinner a game of catch.
Several Springfield-area high school girls tennis players have qualified for the state tournament, a big honor for local athletes this fall.

music.line: Ella Langley is celebrating one whole year of her big hit 'Choosin' Texas,' saying she is constantly and consistently amazed by how the song took off.
Morgan Wallen is curating his very own around-the-clock SiriusXM channel called Morgan Wallen Radio, so fans can hear his picks twenty-four hours a day.
Luke Bryan says his new collaboration with Luke Combs, 'Finders Keepers,' checks all the boxes, and he cannot wait to work it up with the band and perform it.
Zach Bryan just released a new eight-song EP called 'Young Manhood and Other Donatable Organs' and promoted it with a two-hour interview with Matthew McConaughey.
Vince Gill joined his wife Amy Grant and their daughter Jenny for a heartwarming family performance celebrating thirty-five years at the Grand Ole Opry.
A Miranda Lambert exhibit is coming to the National Cowgirl Museum in Fort Worth, Texas, honoring one of country music's biggest stars.
Taste of Country ranked the top ten Riley Green songs, a list that runs from heartbreaking ballads to rowdy honky-tonkers and at least one big smash.
Miley Cyrus paid a powerful tribute to Dolly Parton on stage at the Hollywood Bowl, and fans are calling her words so moving.
Grammy winner Richard Marx says rising country star Justin Fabus has the one thing every artist needs to make it big.
